name: 8D-J8
description: 8D-J8 was an 8D-series smelter droid manufactured by Roche Hive. At one time, the droid was aboard the sail barge of Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine. He was later purchased by the butcher Bakkar and brought to the Outer Rim planet Batuu, where he was reprogrammed by the droid builder Mubo to serve as the pitmaster turning the spit at Bakkar's Ronto Roasters restaurant.
